searches.answer: Docker Desktop 4.51.0 integrates improvements with Kind (Kubernetes in Docker), ensuring that only required dependency images are pulled if they aren’t already available locally, reducing unnecessary downloads and speeding up cluster setup. Kubernetes 1.20 introduces a deprecation warning for Docker runtime support, which will be removed in future releases, specifically planned for version 1.22 next year. Kubernetes is shifting towards container runtimes like containerd and CRI-O, and Dockershim will be removed from Kubelet as early as v1.23 release. Kubernetes clusters are not automatically upgraded with Docker Desktop updates, and must be manually reset to upgrade.
